mapper.select: SELECT s.*, o.org_name AS orgName FROM agri_md_supplier s LEFT JOIN agri_md_organization o ON s.org_id = o.id WHERE s.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY s.create_time DESC
SELECT s.*, o.org_name AS orgName FROM agri_md_supplier s LEFT JOIN agri_md_organization o ON s.org_id = o.id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.del_flag = 0
SELECT * FROM agri_md_supplier WHERE supplier_code = #{supplierCode} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT s.id, s.supplier_code, s.supplier_name, s.short_name, s.supplier_type, s.org_id, s.credit_code, s.legal_person, s.contact_person, s.contact_phone, s.address, s.level, s.status, s.tenant_id, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.remark, o.org_name AS orgName FROM agri_md_supplier s LEFT JOIN agri_md_organization o ON o.id = s.org_id
ORDER BY s.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
